coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 record (translational subset). Two arms are routes of administration (IV vs Ommaya reservoir into the tumour cavity), coded new_route. Ommaya reservoir treated as ordinary access device, not device-enabled delivery, so device_dependent false (adjudicator may check). tumour_pk_planned coded yes from tumour time-activity curves/dosimetry (drug-bound radioactivity in tumour); formal PK is blood and urine only. NOTA-PRGD2 listed as diagnostic agent because tracer uptake is required for every patient.
